name: Majo ni Naritai!
source:
Emy is a school girl who does not have confidence in either knowledge or appearance. She is ready to sign a contract with devil to become a witch and life a totally different life from the current boring one. Devil's lesson how to become a witch begins!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
艾米是一个对自己的知识和外貌都没有信心的女学生。她准备和恶魔签订契约成为魔女，过上与现在无聊生活完全不同的日子。恶魔的魔女课程开始了！

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
